legal_basis: DGO State Budget archive route for reports proposals laws and maps
calculation_rule: Ex ante budget documents must be extracted before classifying annual appropriations as fixed formula residual or settlement
notes: Observed archive route only; not evidence of underfunding or deficit without annual legal and account extraction.

legal_basis: Tribunal de Contas AEO 2013 Social Security account report section on CGA financing sources
calculation_rule: CGA financing sources are reported separately from applications of funds and must be classified before interpretation
notes: Account presentation rule only; transfers and contributions remain distinct and are not evidence of underfunding by themselves.

legal_basis: Decreto-Lei 127/2011 articles 1 to 4 and financing provisions
calculation_rule: State finances assumed bank-pension responsibilities through a specific transfer to Social Security separate from ordinary subsystem financing
notes: Special financing rule only; executed annual amounts and residual components must be extracted before evaluating cost or deficit implications.

legal_basis: Decreto-Lei 127/2011 and CGE 2011 bank pension-fund transfer reporting
calculation_rule: Transferred bank pension-fund assets are a State financing or liquidity resource but not a current employer contribution or ordinary balancing transfer
notes: Asset receipt does not by itself establish consolidated public-finance gain loss underfunding or legal contribution compliance.

legal_basis: Decreto-Lei 88/2012 BPN-group pension responsibilities and financial means
calculation_rule: Financial means are transferred to CGA to cover specified BPN-group pension responsibilities under a separate perimeter
notes: BPN case is separate from the DL127 Social Security perimeter and is not evidence of ordinary CGA underfunding by itself.
